item.title: Finding Nerd Fonts in Neovim
item.author: Michael Park
item.description: I have been writing quite a few presentations in presenterm and was repeatedly going over to the nerd font website to search for the icon that I wanted to pick copying it, then pasting it in neovim. Surely... there is a better way.
